items.author: DRLogvinovich
items.descZh: 杨-米尔斯质量间隙问题作为千禧年大奖难题，传统研究聚焦于在非紧R^4上构造正测度量子场论，而本工作则从形式化角度切入。该仓库提供基于Lean 4的严格形式化证明，核心文件RoundSquare.lean通过74项公理检查，系统验证了规范构造路径的内在矛盾。其主要亮点是证明了在纯非紧R^4的规范框架下，完整的OS/Wightman公理体系与严格谱质量间隙相互排斥，即所谓“圆方”不可兼得，从而为该问题的特定 formulation 提供了负向解决方案。此外，工作还在紧致可构造流形S^4 x T^3上展示了自动谱间隙性质，拓展了形式化方法的适用范围。该成果适用于对数学基础、形式化证明及杨-米尔斯理论有深入研究需求的学者与开发者。
items.quote: 我们并没有通过在 ℝ⁴ 上构建正向测度来解决 Clay Yang-Mills 问题，并且我们证明了为什么没有人应该尝试使用这些工具在纯 ℝ⁴ 上解决该问题。

items.desc: image: https://img.itch.zone/aW1nLzMxODU4MzczLnBuZw==/original/lphyf9.png description: Grow an empire by winning hearts, not fights. [Follow neojexFollowFollowing neojexFollowing](https://itch.io/login?intent=follow%5Fuser&return%5Fto=https%3A%2F%2Fneojex.itch.io%2Fmindblobs) [Add To CollectionCollection](https://itch.io/login?intent=add%5Fto%5Fcollection&return%5Fto=https%3A%2F%2Fneojex.itch.io%2Fmindblobs) [Comments](https://neojex.itch.io/mindblobscomments) [Devlog](https://neojex.itch.io/mindblobs/devlog) [ Related gamesRelated](https://itch.io/gameslike/5304610/mindblobs) Mind Blobs Run game Mind Blobs is a cosy realtime strategy game about cartoon blobs. You win them over instead of beating them up. Lead the Blue Blobs across a little island full of wandering strangers. Send your friendliest blobs to chat with a crowd and watch them join you, one heart at a time. Build houses so your town has room for babies. Build schools to pass on your best blobs' traits, labs to advance your tech, and markets for gold. Friendship Fountains win over visitors while you're busy elsewhere. Rival towns are after the same strangers. The Peachy Pals are friendly. The Grumble Gang would rather bonk first. Violence is quick, but police arrest attackers, even your own, and everyone trusts you a little less. Take over rival buildings, win over most of the island's blobs, and you win. Every blob has 13 traits, like charm, kindness, honesty, strength and patience. Each one changes how it acts, what it can teach and who it can convince. Casual mode: a relaxed pace, played with taps, made for phones and tablets. Pro mode: faster, with hotkeys, box select, control groups and every stat on show. Tutorials: short levels in each mode, each teaching one or two ideas. Controls Casual (touch or mouse): tap one of your blue blobs to select it, then tap a stranger to befriend their crowd. Tap a rival building to take it over. Tap a building button, then tap your land to build. The Team button finds your best blobs. Drag to move the camera, and pinch to zoom. Pro (keyboard and mouse): click or drag a box to select. Rightclick a stranger to befriend, a teammate to teach, or a rival building to take it over. Q W E R T Y build. Ctrl+19 sets a group and 19 picks it. Tab opens your team. Mouse wheel zooms, rightdrag or the arrow keys pan, and H jumps home. Space pauses, + and change speed, and M mutes. items.title: Show HN: I built a tool to check website access for 14 AI crawlers
items.desc: title: "AI Crawler Access Checker: GPTBot, ClaudeBot FloxoLab" description: "Check if GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and 11 more AI crawlers can read a page: robots.txt, firewall answers, noindex, raw HTML text, llms.txt." canonical: "https://floxolab.com/aicrawlerchecker" FLOXOLAB / AI CRAWLER ACCESS CHECKER AI crawler access checker: can AI crawlers read this page? Enter a URL. The checker reads its robots.txt, requests the page with the user agent of 14 AI crawlers, and compares each answer with a normal browser request. You get a verdict per crawler and the line to change. robots.txt says what a crawler may fetch. Your CDN decides what it actually gets. How the check works ↓ Free · No account · 8 checks per 10 minutesWhat it can't tell you ↓ Check a URL 01 / METHOD What the check does 1. Browser baseline. Requests the page with an ordinary desktop browser user agent. If this request is refused too, the site blocks automated requests in general, and crawlerspecific results are marked unknown. 2. robots.txt, per crawler and per URL. Reads /robots.txt from the host that serves the page and applies RFC 9309: the group naming the crawler wins over Useragent: , the longest matching rule wins, and Allow wins a tie. A robots.txt that answers 5xx or 429 counts as “disallow everything”; a 404 counts as “no rules”. Cloudflare ContentSignal lines are reported. 3. One request per crawler user agent. Requests the page again with each crawler's user agent, reads only the status code and headers, and compares them with the browser answer. GoogleExtended and ApplebotExtended are robots.txt tokens only, so the request uses Googlebot and Applebot, which fetch for them. 4. Page directives. Reads meta name="robots", crawlernamed meta tags and XRobotsTag headers, including ones scoped to one crawler, such as GPTBot: noindex. 5. Text without JavaScript. Counts words in the raw HTML after removing scripts, styles and templates. Many AI crawlers fetch HTML without running JavaScript, so a clientrendered page can look empty to them. 6. Discovery files. Checks /llms.txt, the sitemap declared in robots.txt (or /sitemap.xml) and the canonical URL. Allowed robots.txt permits the URL and the crawler's user agent gets the page. Partial it can fetch the page, but something limits use: noindex, nosnippet, rate limiting, almost no text without JavaScript, or a robots.txt rule a userinitiated agent may not follow. Blocked robots.txt disallows the URL, robots.txt is unreachable, or the server refuses that user agent while serving a browser. Unknown our request can't settle it, for example when the site refuses every request from our server or verifies crawler IP addresses. 02 / LIMITS What this checker can't tell you Requests come from FloxoLab's server, not from OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. Some CDNs check whether a request claiming to be a crawler comes from that vendor's published IP ranges. Such a CDN may refuse our request and still admit the real crawler, or the opposite. When a site even refuses our GooglebotUA request, the report flags this and marks useragent blocks as unknown. Crawler requests read headers only. A bot challenge that answers a crawler user agent with HTTP 200 and a challenge page is not detected; one that answers 403, 429 or 503 is. One request, one moment. Rate limits, geo rules and A/B bot rules can change between requests. Server logs remain the proof of what a real crawler received. Access is not inclusion. An allowed crawler may still never visit, index, cite or train on the page. Some user agents are not published. Anthropic documents its robots.txt tokens but not full useragent strings, and ByteDance has no official Bytespider page we could verify. For those, the request uses the format seen in server logs; the report says so. Userinitiated agents. OpenAI and Perplexity say ChatGPTUser and PerplexityUser may not follow robots.txt, because a person asked for the page. A robots.txt rule therefore only makes them “partial”. noai / noimageai. These meta values are a community convention. None of the vendors below documents them as a control, so the report lists them without counting them as a block. No JavaScript rendering, no login. The checker reads raw HTML up to 3 MB and does not follow pages behind authentication. Only ports 80 and 443 are checked; private, local and internal network addresses are refused. 03 / CRAWLERS The 14 crawlers tested Tokens, purposes and user agents checked against each vendor's documentation on November 6, 2026. robots.txt token Vendor Purpose Follows robots.txt Source GPTBot OpenAI Model training Yes [OpenAI bots](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/bots) OAISearchBot OpenAI ChatGPT search Yes [OpenAI bots](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/bots) ChatGPTUser OpenAI Userinitiated fetch May not apply [OpenAI bots](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/bots) ClaudeBot Anthropic Model training Yes [Anthropic help](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8896518doesanthropiccrawldatafromthewebandhowcansiteownersblockthecrawler) ClaudeSearchBot Anthropic Search quality Yes [Anthropic help](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8896518doesanthropiccrawldatafromthewebandhowcansiteownersblockthecrawler) ClaudeUser Anthropic Userinitiated fetch Yes [Anthropic help](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8896518doesanthropiccrawldatafromthewebandhowcansiteownersblockthecrawler) PerplexityBot Perplexity Search index Yes [Perplexity bots](https://docs.perplexity.ai/guides/bots) PerplexityUser Perplexity Userinitiated fetch Generally ignores [Perplexity bots](https://docs.perplexity.ai/guides/bots) GoogleExtended Google Gemini training and grounding; token only, fetched by Googlebot Yes [Google crawlers](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawlingindexing/googlecommoncrawlers) ApplebotExtended Apple Generative AI training; token only, fetched by Applebot Yes [About Applebot](https://support.apple.com/enus/119829) CCBot Common Crawl Open web archive used f
items.author: floxolab
items.descZh: 随着 AI 大模型训练与搜索对网页内容的依赖日益加深，网站所有者迫切需要精准评估各类 AI 爬虫的访问权限，Floxolab 推出的 AI Crawler Access Checker 提供了这一免费检测方案。该工具通过模拟 14 种主流 AI 爬虫的用户代理发起请求，综合解析 robots.txt、服务器响应、页面 meta 指令、无 JavaScript 文本内容及 llms.txt 等文件，为每种爬虫生成 Allowed、Partial、Blocked 或 Unknown 的判定，并明确指出需调整的配置行。其核心亮点在于完全免费且无需注册，每 10 分钟可执行 8 次检查，覆盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、Perplexity 等主流生态，并特别统计去除脚本后的纯文本词数，揭示客户端渲染页面对 AI 爬虫的潜在“隐形”风险。检测过程严格遵循 RFC 9309 规则，同时考虑 CDN 防火墙、速率限制及用户发起型 agent 的特殊行为，帮助识别 noindex 等隐性限制。该工具适用于网站所有者、SEO 人员及内容策略师，用于审计网站在 AI 时代的可访问性，优化内容开放与安全控制的平衡。

"rustfmt.toml") View all files Repository files navigation shiplist shiplist puts every file in your repository in exactly one list, and removes each list before its stage of the build. CI fails when a file isn't in a list, so every new file needs a decision about whether it ships. Then it checks what actually shipped: a Docker image, an npm package, a gem, a wheel, a crate or any other tar or zip file. $ shiplist check Files in no list (add each to exactly one list): config/partner_rates.yml It's a small, static Rust binary for CI pipelines, Docker builds and release workflows. It's most useful when what you build leaves your hands: an image for an onpremise install, or a package anyone can download from a registry. Why A .dockerignore or an rm rf in a Dockerfile is a list of files to leave out, so anything new ships until someone adds it to the list: a setup script with a test key in it, a folder of internal notes, a new tool's config. And the tests run on the full repository, so they can pass while the image is missing a file the code reads. shiplist turns that around: Every tracked file is in exactly one list. shiplist check takes the file list from git lsfiles and fails when a file is in no list or in two. Each list is removed before a named stage. You define the stages, such as test and production. CI prunes the test list before running the tests, so code that reads a file production won't have fails in CI instead of in production. Patterns that match nothing fail. The config can't fill up with paths for files that were deleted years ago. What you ship gets checked too. git never sees what the build creates, such as source maps, so shiplist verifychecks the real build directory, an image saved with docker save, or a package, against the config. The lists work like doubleentry bookkeeping: a file that one list leaves out (with an exclude) has to be claimed by another list, and a file claimed twice is an error. So adding or changing a pattern can never quietly move a file into or out of your image: any overlap fails the check, and someone decides. Install With Homebrew, on macOS or Linux: brew install docspring/tap/shiplist With Cargo, from [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/shiplist): cargo install shiplist locked In GitHub Actions, the action installs the release with its tag, after checking the binary's build provenance: uses: DocSpring/shiplist@v0.1.1 run: shiplist check Or download a binary for Linux (x86\_64 or arm64, static) or macOS from the [releases](https://github.com/DocSpring/shiplist/releases). items.author: nathan_f77
items.descZh: shiplist 是一款专为 CI/CD 和 Docker 构建流程设计的轻量级 Rust 工具，旨在从源头杜绝开发文件、测试密钥及敏感配置泄露到最终交付物（如 Docker 镜像或软件包）中。其核心机制是强制仓库中的每个 tracked 文件都必须且只能归入唯一的清单，并在特定构建阶段（如测试或生产构建）前自动清除对应文件。工具采用类似复式记账法的严格校验逻辑，任何文件未被收录或被多条规则重叠匹配都会直接导致 CI 失败，同时禁止配置中存在匹配不到文件的无效路径，防止配置库冗余。此外，它还支持对实际构建产物（如 docker save 镜像或各类压缩包）进行最终一致性校验（verify），确保实际交付物与配置预期完全一致。该工具适用于对安全合规要求严苛的企业本地化部署、开源项目发布，以及需要严格隔离测试与生产环境资源的复杂流水线。
items.quote: Shiplist 会将仓库中的每个文件放入一个列表中，并在构建阶段前删除每个列表。
